zh-CN.title: Niko 来到言浪
items: 新增 Niko 毛团聊天气泡，使用象牙白与猫眼绿呈现双方消息
新增 Niko 巡游头像框，小猫会沿头像四周持续奔跑
Niko 主题已适配真实聊天、多媒体卡片与深色模式

en.title: Niko arrives in Sermo
items: Added the Niko Fluff chat bubble with ivory and cat-eye green styles for both sides
Added the Niko Patrol avatar frame with a cat running around the portrait
The Niko theme now supports real chats, media cards, and dark mode
